pros: Marked 'ALL INCLUSIVE' incl. domestic flights and transfers
Porter for 15kg personal luggage explicitly included

Honestly flags Day 5 as a steep, relentless tough climb

pros: Domestic flights Islamabad-Gilgit both ways included
Smallest trek group, capped at 7 max
Luxury Prado transport and 3 meals daily
Twin-sharing tents, medical/first-aid kit, porters/mules included
cons: Page shows $0; actual pricing not displayed
Glacier crossing on Day 4 adds technical difficulty
Trip-cancellation insurance excluded
Deposit required 50 days ahead
verdict: Flight-based, small-group (max 7) option with luxury transport and porters/mules included, but the $0 pricing placeholder means you must contact them for a quote.
excludes: International airfare, Pakistan visa fee, trip-cancellation insurance, and ~8 other personal items.
